_README: Scaffold for opt-in autonomous gate approval. Copy, replace every REQUIRED value, and pass as args.autonomy to sdlc-pm-orchestration. OMIT this entirely and EVERY gate escalates to the human (default-safe). The gate-approver fails closed: anything not explicitly on autoApprove.allowlist is escalated; alwaysEscalate is reinforcing. See rules/workflow-gated-actions.md.
run: REQUIRED: short description or ticket id this grant applies to

paths: REQUIRED: globs this run may touch, e.g. src/**, tests/**

allowlist: local commit on a feature branch in an isolated worktree

alwaysEscalate: deploy or promote to any shared/prod environment
terraform apply/destroy or any apply to real infrastructure
outward-facing sends (email/SMS/push, paid or external APIs)
relaxing a security gate or accepting a risk waiver
